fullContent:
Vrihat Vangeshwar Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Rasendra Sara Sangraha Prameha Rogadhikara 27 – 34 
 Vrihat Vangeshwar Ras is an Ayurvedic medicine in tablet form, used in the treatment of frequent urination. This medicine contains metal ingredients, hence should only be taken under strict medical supervision. This medicine is most commonly used in north Indian Ayurvedic practice. 
 Ingredients 
 12 g fine powder of each of: 
 
 Vanga Bhasma – Tin Calx 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Purified Sulphur 
 Rajata Bhasma – Bhasma of Silver 
 Camphor – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Abhraka Bhasma – Purified and processed Mica 
 
 Take in (smaller quantity): 
 
 Swarna Bhasma – Bhasma of Gold – 3 g 
 Mukta Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Pearl – 3 g 
 Bhringaraja – Eclipta alba – juice extract – quantity sufficient 
 
 How to Make? 
 First of all make kajjali. Add all the ingredients add bhringraj juice to make its small tablets. 
 Dosage 
 
 125 – 250 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is advised along with goat milk, cow milk or curd. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Immunity enhancer 
 Sexual power enhancer 
 Sperm production 
 Diabetes 
 Frequent urination 
 Balances vata, pitta and kapha 
 
 Side Effects 
 Note – Avoid Self-medication with this medicine. It should be taken under medical supervision in prescribed dose for limited period of time or as advised by doctor. Over-dosage may cause severe poisonous effect. 
 It is best avoided in pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
